server: uv run uvicorn autotester.ui.app:app (bound worktree D:/autoTesting/.worktrees/t125-catalog, AUTOTESTER_ROOT pointed at an isolated scratch data dir, never the bound tree's own project data)
fixture: scratch project 'demo': two flows (login flow needing {{SECRET:DEMO_PASSWORD}}, Google sign-up flow needing {{SECRET:GOOGLE_SIGNUP_TOKEN}}), approved FlowSpec, neither secret value set, default write_policy=read_only

observations: Case-class table shows a genuine three-state mix: runnable rows in the green pill (e.g. happy, network_offline_slow), blocked-with-reason rows in the warning pill naming the reason and action (double_submit -> 'needs a wider write policy ...'; auth_wrong_creds / auth_expired_session -> 'missing credential ...').

Standard-packs table shows the not-applicable state distinctly: Month/year picker and Excel column-mapping upload both render 'not applicable' (Applicable=no) while OAuth sign-up carry-over renders 'missing credential' (Applicable=yes) -- the three states (runnable / blocked-with-reason / not-applicable) are textually distinguishable within the same page, confirming the builder's claimed 3-way distinction is not collapsed to two on this page.

DEFECT (filed ISS-t125-2): auth_wrong_creds, auth_expired_session AND the OAuth pack all render the identical action text 'set DEMO_PASSWORD, GOOGLE_SIGNUP_TOKEN in the repo-root .env' -- i.e. every missing_credential row names BOTH missing keys project-wide, not just the key its own flow actually needs. A person reading auth_wrong_creds's row would be told (incorrectly) that setting GOOGLE_SIGNUP_TOKEN is part of unblocking it.

The one console error is the browser's own 'Failed to load resource: 404' log for the main document -- expected for an intentional 404 (matches test_catalog_page_404s_for_an_unknown_project); not a defect.
